name: Sable Charter Live
description: Axiom Corp's flagship news and current affairs program, broadcast nightly from a purpose-built studio in the Spire's media district, presenting ninety minutes of curated Meridian news through an explicitly Axiom-aligned editorial lens. The show's longtime anchor, Priya Osei-Nakamura's former colleague Benedikt Ferreira-Chandra, delivers economic analysis, corponation relations coverage, and lifestyle segments with the practiced authority of someone who has never been asked to report something that would harm his employer. The program is technically available to all tiers via basic broadcast but the holographic premium feed — with its interactive sidebar data and live executive commentary — is restricted to Tier 3+.
cultural_impact: The show's consistent framing of corponation security actions as neutral law enforcement established a vocabulary of legitimacy that is now used as a template by corponation legal departments across GLMZ.
story_hooks: The show's missing producer has left a dead drop containing the full unedited communications between the editorial team and Axiom Security dating back six years.
A runner crew is hired to deliver a physical drive to the show's anchor — who turns out to be an unwilling participant in something much larger than they appear on air.
A hacker collective has been inserting single-frame data packets into the holographic broadcast for months; decoding them reveals a structured message from inside Axiom Corp.
